aweskill.name: aweskill
aweskill.desc: AI agent skill pack manager. Install, bundle, and distribute Claude Skills in one command.
aweskill.detail: Manage your Claude agent capabilities like npm packages — install, bundle, and distribute. Cross-agent compatible with built-in health checks.

awescholar.name: awescholar
awescholar.desc: Scientific literature discovery and curation CLI. Search, annotate, filter, and report on academic papers.
awescholar.detail: Automated paper curation workflow: query Semantic Scholar, annotate with LLM, filter by quality, generate Markdown reports.

aweshelf.name: aweshelf
aweshelf.desc: Session bookmark manager. Save, categorize, and restore AI coding sessions with aweswitch profiles.
aweshelf.detail: Bookmark Claude Code and Codex sessions with title and category. Resume sessions with aweswitch profile restoration, browse interactively in a TUI.

aweswitch.name: aweswitch
aweswitch.desc: Agent config switcher. Save and switch Claude runtime configs for different scenarios.
aweswitch.detail: Save independent Claude Code configs per project or scenario. Switch models, permissions, and env vars in one step.

aweteam.name: aweteam
aweteam.desc: AI coding team coordinator. Launch leader-worker multi-agent collaboration in tmux.
aweteam.detail: Launch leader-worker multi-agent collaboration in tmux. Conversations stay in their own panes — traceable and reviewable.

awecolor.name: awecolor
awecolor.desc: Colorize hex color codes in text. Preview and beautify color values in your terminal.
awecolor.detail: Instantly preview hex color codes in your terminal output. Supports named colors and custom palettes.
